'''Porla''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]].

==History==
The Hutt was the master of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]]. Around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ohnaka and several other servants escaped onto Porla's [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]], taking his [[WLO-5 speeder tank/Legends|Ubrikkian tanks]] and [[Starhawk speeder bike/Legends|Starhawk speeder bikes]]. Hondo then ventured to the planet of [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], where he founded a [[Hondo's complex/Legends|base]].
